name: ProgressListItem
intent: The shared row for a progress-details list. One component covers every WBS level via the variant prop: generic (a zone/category/division grouping — an EV rollup + tool count), task (a work item — name/code + schedule badge, EV strip, progress bar), and object (a physical object — name/code + metrics + progress bar). Rows with an onOpen handler drill into the next level.
when: Rendering a WBS drill-down list (zone → category → division → task → object)
One row component spanning grouping, task, and object levels

chooseOver.because: ProgressListItem is the WBS-specific row with EV/schedule/progress variants; Item is the generic list row

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation
